senses.gloss:
तृण् तृण् (according to some, a rt.
formed from the conjugational base of rt.
तृद्), cl. 8. P. A. तृणोति, -णुते, or तर्णोति, -णुते,
&c., to eat (especially grass), to graze; [cf. तृण.]

तृण तृण, अम्, n. (according to the lexi-
cographers also अस्, m.; perhaps connected with the
preceding rt. or fr. rt. स्तृ, to spread, or rt. तॄ, to
pierce, cf. तरु; but according to native authorities
fr. rt. तृह्; according to the conjecture of others,
तृण is for तृण्ण fr. rt. तृद्), grass, a herb or
any gramineous plant, a blade of grass, a bamboo,
a reed, (often a symbol of minuteness and worthless-
ness); straw, grass or reeds for roofing a house [cf.
rt. ज्वल्]; (अस्), m., N. of a man; N. of a prince,
a son of Uśīnara; [cf. Goth. thaurnus; Angl. Sax.
thorn; Germ. dorn; Russ. tern, ‘thorn;’ Hib.
dreas, dris, ‘a briar, bramble.’]
—तृण-कर्ण,
अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants
of this man.
—तृण-काण्ड, अम्, n. a heap or
quantity of grass.
—तृण-कुङ्कुम, अम्, n. a sort
of perfume.
—तृण-कुटी, f. or तृण-कुटीरक,
अम्, n. a hut of grass or straw.
—तृण-कूट, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a heap of grass.
—तृण-कूर्म, अस्, m.
a long gourd, Cucurbita Lagenaria (= तुम्बी).
—तृण-केतकी, f. a kind of Tabāṣīr (तवक्षीर).
—तृण-केतु, उस्, or तृण-केतुक, अस्, m. a bam-
boo; [cf. तृण-ध्वज.]
—तृण-गड, अस्, m. a
sort of sea crab, = उच्-चिङ्गट.
—तृण-गन्धा, f.
Batatas Paniculata, = विदारी; [cf. इक्षु-गन्धा.]
—तृण-गोधा, f. a kind of newt, a chameleon,
a worm, = चित्र-कोल and कृकलास.
—तृण-
गौर, अम्, n. a sort of perfume, = तृण-
कुङ्कुम.
—तृण-ग्रन्थि, इस्, f., N. of a plant,
= स्वर्ण-जीवन्ती.
—तृण-ग्राहिनि, ई, m. sapphire,
= नील-मणि; another gem, commonly काफुर-
दाना, amber, &c., or any gem which being
rubbed becomes electrically attractive.
—तृण-
चर, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a kind of gem, =
गो-मेद.
—तृण-जम्भन्, आ, आ, अ, grass-toothed,
having teeth like grass, &c., graminivorous, feeding
on grass.
—तृण-जलायुका or तृण-जलूका, f.
a caterpillar.
—तृण-जाति, इस्, m. the vegetable
kingdom.
—तृण-ज्योतिस्, a particular kind of
shining plant.
—१. तृण-ता, f. or तृण-त्व, अम्, n.
the aggregate properties of grass or herbage, the
state or condition of grass, gramineousness; (for
2. तृणता see col. 3.)
—तृण-दुह्, -धुक्, m. =
बडवाग्नि.
—तृण-द्रुम, अस्, m. a palm-tree,
any of the various species, as the palmyra, cocoa-nut,
date, &c.; [cf. तृण-वृक्ष.]
—तृण-धान्य,
अम्, n. grain growing wild or without cultivation;
[cf. तृणान्न.]
—तृण-ध्वज, अस्, m. a bamboo;
[cf. तृण-केतु.]
—तृण-निम्ब, अस्, m. a kind of
Nimba growing in Nepal (नेपाल-निम्ब); Aga-
thotes Chirayta (किरात-तिक्त) — तृण-प, अस्, m.,
[]
N. of a Gandharva.
—तृण-पञ्च-मूल, अम्, n.
an aggregate of five roots of gramineous plants, viz.
of rice, sugar-cane, Darbha, Scirpus Kysoor (क-
शेरु), and a cane similar to Saccharum Sara (=
शर).
—तृण-पत्त्रिका, f. a kind of sugar-cane
(इक्षु-दर्भा).
—तृण-पत्त्री, f. a kind of grass,
= गुण्डाशिनी.
—तृण-पदी, f. having legs as thin
as blades of grass.
—तृण-पाणि, इस्, m., N. of a
Ṛṣi.
—तृण-पीड, अम्, n. pressing as close as
grass, hand to hand fighting, close quarters.
—तृण-
पुष्प, अम्, n. a kind of perfume, = तृण-कुङ्-
कुम; (ई), f. a kind of plant, = सिन्दूर-पुष्पी.
—तृण-पूलक = तृण-पूली (?) .
—तृण-पूली,
f. a mat, a seat made of reeds or basket-work.
—तृण-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, worth a straw, worth-
less.
—तृण-मणि, इस्, m. ‘straw-attracting gem,’
a sort of gem, apparently amber; [cf. तृण-ग्रा-
हिन्.]
—तृण-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting or made
of grass, grassy.
—तृण-मुष्टि, इस्, f. a handful of
grass.
—तृण-राज्, ट्, m. ‘the king of the grasses,’
the vine-palm.
—तृण-राज, अस्, m. ‘the king of
the grasses,’ the palm or the palmyra-tree, Borassus
Flabelliformis; the cocoa-nut tree; bamboo; sugar-
cane.
—तृण-राजन्, आ, m. ‘the king of the grasses,’
the vine-palm.
—तृण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, abounding
in grass, grassy.
—तृण-वल्व-ज, अस् or अम्, m. or
n. (?), Saccharum Cylindricum; (आ), f. = वल्व-जा.
—तृण-विन्दु, उस्, m., N. of an ancient sage and
prince; [cf. तार्णविन्दवीय.]
—तृणविन्दु-सरस्,
अस्, m., N. of a lake.
—तृण-विस्तर, अस्, m. a
heap of grass.
—तृण-वीज or तृण-वीजक or तृ-
णवीजोत्तम (˚ज-उत्˚), अस्, m. a kind of grain, =
श्यामाक.
—तृण-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the fan-palm;
the date tree; the cocoa-nut tree; the areca-nut
tree; Pandanus Odoratissimus; [cf. तृण-द्रुम.]
—तृण-शीत, अम्, n. a kind of fragrant grass, An-
dropogon Serratus; (आ), f. a kind of aquatic plant,
= जल-पिप्पली.
—तृण-शून्य, अस्, m. Jasmi-
num Sambac; the fruit of Pandanus Odoratissimus.
—तृण-शूली, f. a kind of plant.
—तृण-शोणित,
अम्, n. a kind of perfume, = तृण-कुङ्कुम; [cf.
तृणासृज्.]
—तृण-शोषक, अस्, m. a kind of ser-
pent.
—तृण-शौण्डिका, f. a kind of Achyranthes.
—तृण-षट्पद, अस्, m. a wasp (‘an insect with
six feet infesting grass’).
—तृण-सारा, f. the plan-
tain or banana, Musa Sapientum.
—तृण-सिंह,
अस्, m. an axe (‘a reed lion’).
—तृण-सोमाङ्गिरस्
(˚म-अङ्˚), आस्, m., N. of one of the seven sacrificial
priests of Yama.
—तृण-स्कन्द, अस्, m., Ved., N.
of a man; (Sāy.) trembling or fading away like
grass.
—तृण-हर्म्य, अस्, m. a house or upper
room of grass or straw.
—तृणांह्रिप (˚ण-अं˚),
अस्, m. a kind of grass, = मन्थानक-तृण; (also
read तृणाङ्घ्रिप.)
—तृणाग्नि (˚ण-अग्˚), इस्, m.
a grass fire, i. e. one quickly extinguished; confla-
gration of straw or chaff; burning a criminal wrapped
up in straw.
—तृणाञ्जन (˚ण-अञ्˚), अस्, m. a
chameleon, a lizard.
—तृणाटवी (˚ण-अट्˚), f. a
forest abounding in grass.
—तृणाढ्य (˚ण-आढ्˚),
अस्, m. a kind of grass, = पर्वत-तृण; [cf. पत्-
त्राढ्य.]
—तृणान्न (˚ण-अन्˚), अम्, n. rice grow-
ing wild; [cf. तृण-धान्य.]
—तृणाम्ल (˚ण-
अम्˚), अम्, n. a kind of grass, = लवण-तृण.
—तृणारि (˚ण-अरि), इस्, m. a kind of Mollugo, (a
common weed.)
—तृणावर्त (˚ण-आव्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a man.
—तृणावर्त-वध, अस्, m., N. of
a chapter of the Gaṇeśa-khaṇḍa or third part of the
Brahmavaivarta-Purāṇa.
—तृणा-वल्ली-तीर्थ, N.
of a place mentioned in the Rasika-ramaṇa by
Raghu-nātha.
—तृणासृज् (˚ण-अस्˚), क्, n. a kind
of perfume, = तृण-कुङ्कुम, तृण-शोणित.
—तृ-
णेक्षु (˚ण-इक्˚), उस्, m. a kind of long grass,
Saccharum Cylindricum.
—तृणेन्द्र (˚ण-इन्˚), अस्,
m. ‘prince of the grasses,’ the palmyra-palm (=
ताल); [cf. तृण-राज.]
—तृणोत्तम (˚ण-उत्˚),
अस्, m. ‘best of grasses,’ a kind of Andropogon (उखर्-
वल).
—तृणोत्थ (˚ण-उत्˚), अस्, m. a kind of
perfume, = तृण-कुङ्कुम.
—तृणोदक (˚ण-
उद्˚), अम्, n. grass and water.
—तृणोद्भव (˚ण-
उद्˚), अस्, m. rice &c. growing wild or without culti-
vation; a kind of perfume, = तृणोत्थ.
—तृणोलप
[]
(˚ण-उल्˚), अम्, n. grass and shrubs.
—तृणोल्का
(˚ण-उल्˚), f. a torch of hay; a fire-brand made of a
wisp of straw.
—तृणौकस् (˚ण-ओक्˚), अस्, n. a hut,
a house of straw or mats.
—तृणौषध (˚ण-
ओष्˚), अम्, n. the fragrant bark of Feronia Elephan-
tum (= एलवालुक).
तृण्ण तृण्ण. See under rt. तृद् below.
तृण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, split, pierced, cut, injured, &c.

तृणक, अम्, n. grass, a worthless blade of grass;
(अस्), m., N. of a man.
तृणस, अस्, आ, अम्, grassy, abounding in grass, &c.

तृणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make straw
of, to make light of.
—तृणी-कृत्य, having esteemed
as lightly as straw.
तृणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to grass (?).
तृण्या, f. a heap or quantity of grass or straw.

तृणता 2. तृणता, f. (for 1. see under तृण,
col. 1), a bow, = त्रिणता.

तृणमत्कृण तृणमत्कृण or तृणमत्कुण,
अस्, m. a bail or surety, security, warranty; (the right
reading may be ऋणमत्कुण.)

तृणाङ्कु तृणाङ्कु, उस्, m., N. of an ancient
sage.

तृणामल्ल तृणामल्ल, N. of a temple; (also
read त्रिणामल्ल and त्रिमल्ल and तृणावल्ली-
तीर्थ.)

तृणावर्त; add — N. of a demon killed by the
infant Kṛṣṇa.
